catchmentName: Boston Longwood Medical Area & Muddy River Catchment
description: Geographically grounded hydraulic simulation dataset covering the Longwood Medical Area and Muddy River corridor in Boston and Brookline, MA, referenced to EPSG:26986.

attribution.topography: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1-meter Bare Earth DEM resampled in EPSG:26986

grid.orientation: Row 0 is North (Y=899500), Row 63 is South (Y=897900); Col 0 is West (X=231650), Col 63 is East (X=233250)

elevationStatistics.resamplingMethod: Bilinear spatial aggregation in EPSG:26986 directly from USGS 1m Bare Earth LiDAR to 25.0m square cells

criticalFacilities.name: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (West Campus)
Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (East Campus)

modelledDrainageInlets.name: Brookline Avenue Muddy River Culvert Inflow
modelledDrainageInlets.modellingRationale: Major hydraulic culvert transition where Muddy River passes beneath Brookline Avenue into the Fenway conduit.

modelledDrainageInlets.name: Fenway Emerald Necklace Choke Point
modelledDrainageInlets.modellingRationale: Historic flood restriction point subject to debris accumulation during high overland storm runoff. Capacity is an adjustable planning-level assumption.

modelledDrainageInlets.name: Assumed Overland Sump Inflow (Longwood Low Basin)
modelledDrainageInlets.modellingRationale: Generic assumed municipal drainage sink representing localized gravity catch basin aggregation in the Longwood low basin. Not a documented municipal pump station. Capacity is an adjustable planning-level assumption.
